techniques.evidence: features/overeni/liveFigures.ts:190 The vocabulary is closed at verdict.ts:29 and copy is returned as keys. But a failed loader yields unknown/'zaznam-nenalezen' (record gone) instead of an unevaluable state, against 'An unavailable loader ... yields unknown with an unevaluable reason, never a content verdict'. The law branch handles this correctly (getLawData null -> unavailable); the score and money branches do not.

features/overeni/refDetect.ts:278 The figura decoder (lib/claims/claim.ts:108) URI-decodes segments with no re-encode equality check, so a percent-encoded alias of an issued claim ref (e.g. %70 for 'p' in the metric) decodes to the same parts, and resolveLiveFigure verifies it. The zdroj family does this correctly (claimRef.ts:78).
features/overeni/verdict.ts:143 Same value with a different derivation gives moved/basis. If either side lacks a stamp, the stamps are not compared.

features/overeni/verdict.ts:305 Tone is verdict x standing, computed in one place. Ungated is a first-class state (verdict.ts:285). One dictionary merges pending/pending_review and prints unknown tokens verbatim (gateVocabulary.ts).

pairs.registryProposal: claim-ref-addressing's re-encode rule names only the base64 and UTF-8 alias sources; percent-encoded (URI-component) claim refs alias the same way ('%70' == 'p'), so the rule could name percent-encoding explicitly.

techniques.evidence: features/shared/provenance/receipt.ts:363 The gate is enforced inside the emitter (line 353) and the url is absolute-or-none, but datePublished falls back to computedAt. The emission criterion is ReviewRepository approval of a machine-proposed linked_to link, which the technique classes as 'internal pipeline approval alone is insufficient'.

features/shared/provenance/ReceiptBody.tsx:217 The receipt is derived per request (getReceiptData) and weights render exactly (receipt.ts:239), but missing provenance fields (method/pass/computedAt/ref, lines 217-230) are silently omitted instead of shown as 'not recorded'. Golden path: 'Missing fields say they are missing'. The /overeni gate does print row.noMethod; /zdroj does not.

features/shared/provenance/claimRef.ts:78 Self-describing src/rel/dst address, length bound at 512, and a re-encode equality check refuses aliases. Gone addresses get a decoded-claim page (getReceiptData gone + toDecodedClaim).

features/shared/provenance/receipt.ts:182 Only literal terminal states promote. Missing or unrecognized states on a gated relation read as pending, and non-gated relations get gate=null, rendered as an explicit ungated label (ReceiptBody.tsx:199). The raw unrecognized token is not preserved (minor).

pairs.registryProposal: gate-state-as-modifier says both 'unrecognized state on a gated claim reads pending' and 'unknown tokens print verbatim, labelled untranslated'; a receipt that normalizes before the dictionary satisfies the first and silently loses the second. The technique could state which layer must carry the raw token.
